integrity: The all-field proof uses elementary finite-character identities and a symbolic four-dimensional block determinant. Numerical checks at ten fields corroborate but do not prove infinite claims; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact spectrum only for the constant and three coordinate-frequency families on the quadratic graph in odd-characteristic finite fields; it does not classify arbitrary Fourier frequencies or extension-operator bounds. Historical equivalence in finite chirp-frame literature remains a priority risk.
title: Exact seven-level Fourier-frame spectrum on the finite-field paraboloid
